description: Rename AGRO on the two site-only docs pages

userStories.title: Update the Docker deployment page to AGRO names
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the Docker deployment recipe to use the AGRO names, so that the commands work on the current release.
acceptanceCriteria: `docs/docker-deployment.md` uses these replacements, and changes no other text:
`pnpm build` exits 0, and the build log has no broken-link or broken-anchor warning.
The rendered page at `/docs/docker-deployment` shows `ghcr.io/mifunedev/agro:latest` in its first `docker run` block. Verify in browser using agent-browser skill.

userStories.title: Update the model selection page to the AGRO name
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the model selection page to use the AGRO name, so that the page matches the rest of the site.
acceptanceCriteria: `docs/model-selection.md` replaces each `Open Harness` with `AGRO`, and changes no other text.
`pnpm build` exits 0, and the build log has no broken-link or broken-anchor warning.
The rendered page at `/docs/model-selection` shows "AGRO currently consults". Verify in browser using agent-browser skill.
